# netcup_server_settings (Resource)

Settings of an existing netcup server (SCP REST API). Only attributes set in the configuration are managed. netcup cannot create or delete servers, so `destroy` only drops the resource from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage selected settings of an existing server. Attributes left out keep
# their current value.
resource "netcup_server_settings" "web" {
  server_id   = 296155
  hostname    = "web01.example.com"
  nickname    = "web01"
  autostart   = true
  backup_time = "01:30:00+02:00"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Optional

- `autostart` (Boolean) Whether the server starts when its host starts.
- `backup_time` (String) Daily backup start as local time with UTC offset, e.g. `01:30:00+02:00`. Negative offsets are not supported.
- `bootorder` (List of String) Boot devices in order, each one of `HDD`, `CDROM`, `NETWORK`.
- `cpu_cores_per_socket` (Number) Number of CPU cores per socket. Set together with `cpu_sockets`.
- `cpu_sockets` (Number) Number of CPU sockets. Set together with `cpu_cores_per_socket`.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the server.
- `keyboard_layout` (String) Keyboard layout of the server console.
- `nickname` (String) Nickname shown in the SCP.
- `os_optimization` (String) Operating system the virtual hardware is tuned for: `LINUX`, `WINDOWS`, `BSD`, `LINUX_LEGACY` or `UNKNOWN`.
- `power_state` (String) `ON`, `OFF` or `SUSPENDED`. Changing it starts, shuts down or suspends the server.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `uefi` (Boolean) Whether the server boots with UEFI.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Equals `server_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: <server_id>
terraform import netcup_server_settings.web 296155
```
